meta.method: dm.de and rossmann.de category/search pages sorted by relevance (review count used as popularity proxy), cross-checked against existing catalog via Supabase SQL. See selection-batch1-draft.md for full method and confidence notes.
meta.existing_catalog_query: select p.brand, p.name, p.category_key, gtins from products p left join product_identifiers pi ... where category_key in (shampoo,conditioner,leave_in,oil,mask)

pilot.name: Leave-In Creme Aloe Air Dry
pilot.rationale: 959 dm reviews. Note: catalog already has a 'Garnier Hair Food Aloe Vera' leave_in row with no GTIN and no size info - possibly the same product under an older name. Treated as a new candidate rather than existing_product_new_eans because the exact name match could not be confirmed; needs manual reconciliation. FOLLOW-UP 2026-09-02: checked both dm.de and rossmann.de - 'Hair Food Aloe Vera' branding at both retailers is used only for the Haarmaske (mask), Shampoo, and Spülung/Conditioner variants; the leave-in in this same Aloe Vera sub-range is sold under a distinct 'Air Dry' name at both retailers (dm: 'Fructis Hydra Aloe Air-Dry Cream' in the product description; Rossmann: 'Leave-In Creme Hydra Aloe Air-Dry'). No 'Hair Food'-branded leave-in product could be found live at either retailer. This suggests Aloe Air Dry and Hair Food Aloe Vera are two different sub-lines, not the same product under a renamed leave-in SKU - but this is retailer-catalog evidence, not proof about the specific existing DB row's history, so manual reconciliation with Nick is still recommended before merging or dropping either row.
